summary: Wave 2 verification of SWITCH CITY (web+mobile) and SPONSOR GAME BUILDER (web+backend). Backend: 19/19 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter176_switch_city_sponsor_builder.py (geo/me shape, PATCH /api/users/me/market for all 6 markets + 400 for unsupported, sponsor /builder for owner + 403 for non-owner, upsert points-only wheel + validation for no_segments/weights_zero/bad_game_type/invalid_coupon_offer, toggle active, logo upload happy + bad content-type rejection, playability via /api/games/wheel/config + /api/games/wheel/list surfacing, legacy /api/games/wheel/config regression). Web UI: topbar-city-chip mounted in AppShellV2 opens city-chip-sheet with all 6 markets, selecting london updates the chip label AND /api/geo/me?market=london; /merchant/sponsor-games renders sponsor-games-page + sponsor-games-new-btn + full sponsor-builder-modal (wheel/scratch tabs, name/logo url/upload, segments with kind/label/weight/points/offer/color, load-pool, add-slice, daily-spins, save) — publish path creates a sponsor-game-card-<id> in the list. Sidebar shows both legacy 'Games' and new 'Sponsor Games' entries side-by-side; legacy /merchant/games still loads. Mobile: profile tab shows menu-switch-city with current city subtitle; tapping opens city-modal with all 6 city-option-<key> options and selecting london updates the subtitle to 'Currently: London'. IMPORTANT UI GATE FOUND: MerchantShell redirects owners with merchant_status in {draft,submitted,rejected} to /merchant/status, which blocks access to /merchant/sponsor-games until the merchant is approved — test@'s two owned merchants (biz_dc324d800f66, biz_karak_cafe_karama) are BOTH in draft state in the seed, so a fresh preview cannot reach the new page as a business owner. I temporarily promoted biz_dc324d800f66 to approved to exercise the UI, then reverted it and cleaned up test-created branded_games.

integration_issues.issue: No test@ merchant is approved by default (both biz_dc324d800f66 and biz_karak_cafe_karama are merchant_status=draft), so MerchantShell (/app/frontend/src/pages/merchant/MerchantShell.jsx:99-104) hard-redirects owners to /merchant/status and the new /merchant/sponsor-games page is unreachable from a fresh preview. Seeds should include one APPROVED merchant for test@ (or the sponsor-games route should be reachable in the draft flow).

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web deprecation warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' still emitted on multiple screens (already reported in iter175, unrelated to Wave 2).
RN Web deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still present (already reported in iter175, unrelated to Wave 2).

action_items: Seed one APPROVED merchant for test@bigfm.dubai (or automatically approve biz_dc324d800f66 in the demo seeder) so /merchant/sponsor-games is reachable from a fresh preview without dev intervention.
(Optional) Also ensure test@ merchant has at least one active offer so the coupon-slice picker path can be exercised in the UI (the points-only path works fine when offers are empty).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/games/sponsor/{merchant_id}/branded-games correctly validates weights/segments/game_type and enforces ownership via resolve_merchant_with_role — 403 for non-owner is returned by RBAC before the ownership branch runs, so the toggle non-owner test returns 403 instead of 404 (still fine).
instant_games.py:_abs_url normalises relative /api/static/... logos before returning to clients — good for cross-platform (web + expo-image).
geo_routes.PATCH /api/users/me/market normalises input (lower/underscore) and rejects unsupported markets with 400 — matches spec.
sponsor-game-card testID pattern 'sponsor-game-card-<id>' verified live (e.g. sponsor-game-card-wheel_spn_cbf2a7f657).
Segment 'points' testID is only rendered when kind==points (segment 2 was 'Try again' / kind=none in seeded pool) — this is correct behaviour, not a missing testID bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Wave 2 testIDs verified on both surfaces after approving one merchant)

test_credentials: Web: test@bigfm.dubai / TestUser123! (business owner) — required to see /merchant/sponsor-games; demo@bigfm.dubai / DemoPass123! for 403 non-owner checks. Mobile: 'Try the demo' testID demo-login-btn (POST /api/auth/demo → bearer).
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates a TEST_-prefixed sponsor wheel via POST /api/games/sponsor/{merchant_id}/branded-games and cleans nothing (idempotent branded_games doc). UI test created one sponsor-game-card via the modal; both were cleaned up (db.branded_games.deleteMany sponsor_business_id=biz_dc324d800f66). biz_dc324d800f66 merchant_status was temporarily flipped to 'approved' then reverted back to 'draft' after the UI run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The sponsor-games route is gated by MerchantShell status check. To retest the UI without approving a merchant, either (a) approve one of test@'s merchants (mongosh: db.businesses.updateOne({business_id:'biz_dc324d800f66'}, {$set:{merchant_status:'approved'}})) or (b) update the seeder to ship an approved merchant for test@. Backend endpoints are all working; use test_iter176 pytest as a regression check for future sponsor-builder / switch-city changes. Both mobile deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) are pre-existing and were already reported in iter175.
rca of the issue: Not a backend/frontend bug — the Sponsor Games page CANNOT be reached in a clean preview because both merchants seeded for test@bigfm.dubai are in merchant_status='draft' and MerchantShell.jsx forces those owners into the /merchant/status wizard. Recommended fix path: seed the 'TEST_iter57_pickup' merchant as approved in the idempotent seeder so business-owner flows (payment links / games / sponsor games) are exercisable out-of-the-box.
